Baseline d6809df7775338f000e44c8a916067b8866867fb; depth6/calibration6 tied-lowest, no scalar promotion credit. Routed prior outside items1-3 require explicit effective/superseded expectation disposition, new auditable GIT_DIR injection and manifest/runner mapping receipt, and new empirical backlink. Old raw evidence remains byte-identical. Freshness successor sweep plan is considered via bounded intake; no sibling gate execution without an existing owner opt-in/current spec.
# Contract
Root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin. Read /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin/AGENTS.md, PROVINCE.md, corpus/QUALITY.md and corpus/lessons/round-13-verifier-spotcheck.md first. Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin/<that path>. Every seat is leaf: no delegation, background jobs, commits, builds, lint, tests, formatters or verification runs. L1 alone runs integrated checks after all seats finish. Read-only research seats may write only their named report. Implementation seats own only explicitly named absolute paths; do not touch shared LOG/SKILL/SOURCES/SCORECARD/QUALITY/README, sibling repos, fleet files, or historical evidence. Reviews of absent/in-progress code must say so; review retained contracts rather than inventing completion. Message Gate/DispositionSpec/ReceiptHarness via returned exact agent IDs if needed; never agent://all. Tools can install/upgrade after reading /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md; official channels, update-safety gate, record tool/version/channel/reason in report. No credentials. Final report concise with concrete evidence and no independent-verifier claims.

Gate /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin/tools/evidence-disposition.py: stdlib CLI --root LANE --dispositions FILE --json; --selftest using isolated fixtures only. Exit0 clean,1 failed semantic expectations,2 could-not-evaluate bad/missing/tampered input,64 usage. Disposition schema evidence-dispositions-v1: expected_file relative path, inputs map relative path->sha256, rows list objects name/state/receipt/check (effective) or name/state/reason/superseded_by list (superseded). Expected historical file .ufo/evidence/round-13/expected.json; receipt files verification.json and producer-oracle-repair.json same directory. Enumerate expected_checks exactly once in rows. Every effective row selects unique receipt.checks name; enforce original expected exit/contains/id/reason/rows/statuses/result_reuse fields using parsed check.stdout for structured predicates. Superseded producer_before must retain observed raw receipt/check and require both producer_before_oracle and producer_after_oracle effective replacements passing their original expectations; no unexplained/drop/cycle/unknown/missing rows. inputs must pin expected file and every used receipt; verify every original expected.inputs digest too before predicates. Never execute receipt argv. Output stable finding IDs, per-expectation disposition and mismatch details. Isolated selftest invokes own CLI via subprocess and checks exit plus stable IDs. Script owns selftest fixture construction if easier. DispositionSpec creates dispositions-before.json and dispositions.json: identical aside producer_before row state effective->superseded+reason/replacements. All13 expected rows effective except producer_before superseded in after. All prior check rows preserved, no historical rewrite.
ReceiptHarness owns /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin/.ufo/evidence/round-14/capture-context.py only; script is run by L1 later. It reads existing pin probe and unchanged runner, creates new context-receipt.json retaining argv,cwd, explicit injected_env={GIT_DIR:'/nonexistent/tameshi-round14-poison'} (no ambient env dump), outputs and exit codes baseline/injected, comparable JSON minus observed_at, source/manifest digests, and explicit six-leg runner table/PIN_/REV_/leg-call mapping booleans. Do not run target suites or modify historical inputs. Can use subprocess pin probe only when L1 executes harness. Frozen expectation checks and context receipt are distinct: env check is not retrospective repair of omitted round13 setup.
